//: Capability manifest for <Textarea> (the .pa-textarea control) — svelte-pure-admin. Textarea.svelte is a bare <textarea class="pa-textarea {size} {color} {class}">{value}</textarea>. Size + themeColor are the only class axes (core has NO textarea validation-state border — svelte's `state` prop drives aria-invalid only, no class, so it is NOT mapped). value + placeholder + name + id + isDisabled + isReadonly + isRequired emit native attrs. `rows` is NOT mapped (fixed to no always-on default; see the oracle note).
